question: Does per-GT independent native support overstate simultaneous tiny-object capacity when each native position can serve only one GT?
difference: Candidate36 ignored native matching capacity; candidate47 allocated kept cross-view peers to final detections for foreground ranking. This uses all saved pre-threshold/NMS positions against GT to test native simultaneous support, with no final score or coordinate changes. It does not reopen stopped peer ranking, retrieval or training methods.
sample: Exactly candidate56's64screen and64confirmation train images, retaining fixed order and disjoint sequence prefixes. Candidate56 outcomes have been inspected, but no native support graph/capacity outcome was measured before this registration. No selection based on its TP/FP or perturbation results. Images are detector/calibrator training data, not independent generalization data.
inventory: Hash-verified candidate56 saved five-view18900x4local boxes and18900x10FP16 raw logits. Map saved local FP32 boxes to original pixels by local clipping then FP32offset addition. Use float64 sigmoid of saved logits; this diagnostic conversion is explicit, not a replay of rounded decoded FP16 probabilities or a change to original deployed predictions. Exclude only nonfinite logits/coordinates and nonpositive mapped boxes. Native position identity is view*18900+index, with capacity1 across all categories. Equal-coordinate positions remain separate; inter-position NMS and deployment constraints are absent, making capacity optimistic.
graphs: All valid GT are left vertices, native positions right. Primary edges require IoU>=0.5, saved logit argmax equals GTclass and float64sigmoid ofthatlogit>=0.05. Geometry-only control uses identical coordinate edges without any class/score condition. Evaluate each individual view and five-view union. Compute allGT,tiny andsmall_all separately, with GT area*(640/max original dimension)^2<256/1024. Tiny-only capacity gives tiny priority and ignores competition with larger GT; it is an optimistic upper bound, not an all-size allocation policy.
capacity: For each induced graph, independent support=count of GTwithdegree>0. Maximum cardinality matching uses SciPy unweighted bipartite matching. Deficit=independent support minus maximum cardinality; no arbitrary choice of unmatched GT is a ground-truth explanation. Save complete edges, matched positions and Konig minimum vertex-cover certificate. Certificate must cover every edge and have size equal matching cardinality, independently proving optimality. Group matching needs not share exact tie outcomes.
strong_control: Keep candidate56 full ordinary-calibration reference untouched. For descriptive context only, apply historical individual-ignore-IoF>0.5 after predictions and greedily match allGT at0.25/IoU0.5. Do not remove native rows or GT using ignore annotations, or turn oracle graph capacity into deployed recall/AP.
metrics: Per half, all/tiny/small_all perview andunion GT,independent support,matching capacity,deficit and affected-image count. Also original calibrated matched counts, GT exact-duplicate annotation counts and perview contrasts. Primary tiny class/score union deficit fraction uses ALLtinyGT denominator, including unsupported GT.400paired image-resampling draws across all64images,default_rng0, for deficit fraction95CI. Empty images remain in draws; undefined denominator makes interval unavailable and gate fail.
pass: REPLICATED_NATIVE_CAPACITY_DEFICIT_SUPPORTS_SEPARATE_INSTANCE_DIVERSIFICATION_FEASIBILITY. Only licenses a new bounded feasibility design with simple multi-prediction/assignment controls and prior differentiation; not training,AP,deployability or innovation authorization.

prior_boundary: Detection in Crowded Scenes: One Proposal, Multiple Predictions2003.09163v2 already handles similar proposals through correlated instance sets,EMD loss andSetNMS. This is a falsifiable capacity diagnostic,not a new detector.
